purpose: Preserve the approved low-amplitude 7.9 m facade anti-repetition signal from source PNG through Unity texture import so block compression cannot flatten, contour or macroblock the field before formal render evidence.

sourcePrecisionReasoning.risk: The authored field occupies fewer than seven 8-bit code values peak-to-peak. GPU block compression can quantize or spatially block a signal this subtle even when the source PNG and source-pixel integrity checks are exact.
sourcePrecisionReasoning.decision: Keep the deterministic 8-bit source for provenance, but require Unity to import the formal runtime texture uncompressed so the authored code values reach the shader without BC/ASTC-style block quantization.
sourcePrecisionReasoning.memoryTradeoff: A 1024x1024 uncompressed facade macro map plus mip chain costs more GPU memory than block compression, but it is a single benchmark-critical field and the precision benefit is prioritized for the 4K fidelity target.

formalEvidenceGate.preparationBehavior: Apply canonical importer state on editor load and after source reimport via deferred preparation; formal pre-cull only validates.

visualFidelityGateMapping.expectedEffectNotScored: Preserves low-amplitude macro breakup without compression blocks or flattening; mipmaps/trilinear/aniso remain required to avoid grazing-angle shimmer.

failureInjection: set facade macro TextureImporter.textureCompression to CompressedHQ -> formal capture must fail
enable Crunch compression -> formal capture must fail
set Standalone platform override -> formal capture must fail
reduce maxTextureSize below 1024 -> formal capture must fail
disable mipmaps or set Bilinear filtering -> formal capture must fail
reduce anisotropy below 8 -> formal capture must fail
set EditorUserBuildSettings.overrideTextureCompression to ForceFastCompressor -> formal capture must fail

inspectFor: 4x4-style compression blocking or contouring in low-frequency facade breakup
loss of the neutral macro signal compared with source intent
false repeated blocks introduced by texture compression
